name: Easy Reward Program
author: ECLAPIER

sections.description:
Want a simple, smooth, and effective rewards system to turn occasional buyers into loyal customers?

Easy Reward Program is the must‑have tool to convert every purchase into automatic loyalty credit on your WooCommerce store.

Why choose our plugin?

Our plugin is designed specifically for e‑commerce store owners who want to:

  • Boost customer retention: An incentive credit system that encourages customers to return.
  • Automate rewards: Once configured, the program runs on its own without manual intervention.
  • Offer a simple user experience (UX): An intuitive flow from activation to coupon use.

How it works: Rewards in 4 simple steps

  1. Customer activation: The customer activates their rewards account in one click via the “My Rewards” tab in their account area (My Account in WooCommerce).
  2. Purchase and credits: After a confirmed payment, the plugin automatically calculates the number of credits to award and adds them to the customer’s account.
  3. Coupon generation: As soon as the maximum reward threshold is reached, the system generates a unique discount code and immediately emails a confirmation to the customer.
  4. Instant use: To retrieve the voucher, the customer goes to “My Rewards,” clicks their code (it will be copied automatically), and pastes it into the coupon field on their next order.

Key Features

Admin side

  • Credit management: Manually add and remove credits on user accounts. Great for promotions or customer support.
  • Flexible rules: Manage rewards by account type (use currency or points).
  • Easy setup: Quickly configure thresholds and conversion rates via an intuitive slider.

Customer side

  • Dashboard: A clear My Rewards tab accessible at any time.
  • Dynamic display: Informational messages about account status and available rewards shown on the checkout page.

⚠️ Important prerequisite: This plugin is an extension of WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated to work properly.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Easy Reward Program?

Easy Reward Program is a WordPress and WooCommerce extension that rewards customer purchases by accumulating points or virtual currency.

How does Easy Reward Program work?

  1. The customer activates the program from their account, in the Easy Reward Program tab.
  2. They then make purchases on the site.
  3. Once the order is confirmed, the plugin calculates the points earned and adds them to the loyalty account.
  4. When the maximum number of points is reached, a coupon is automatically generated and sent by email.

Does the plugin respect privacy ?

Yes. It is designed to respect user data and is GDPR compliant.

I am an admin. How can I add credits to a user?

  1. Go to the User Management tab.
  2. Search for the user’s name.
  3. Move the slider to choose the amount.
  4. Right‑click Add .
  5. A notification will confirm the credit allocation.

I have an issue. How can I contact support?

You can contact the developer through the plugin support forum or the form from dashboard.

0.9.0

  • Initial release with credit and reward management.

0.9.0

  • Initial release.

Additional notes

  • We use SweetAlert2 for notifications.
  • Forms protected on both client and server sides.
  • Compatible with most WordPress ecosystem themes (Divi, Elementor, FSE).
  • Compatible with WordPress 6.x+.
  • Available languages: EN, FR.
sections.installation:
1. Download and unzip the plugin into the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate it from the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Easy Reward System → My Settings to get started.
